tours.title: Play a sound
tours.description: Make your sprite play a sound.

steps.title: Start a sound
steps.text: This block plays the sound you pick. Click its menu to listen to the choices. Make sure your computer's volume is on.

steps.title: Try it yourself!
steps.text: I've added a “when this sprite clicked” block to your code area. Drag “start sound” under it, then click your sprite to hear it.

waitFor.label: Drag the “start sound” block under the hat block

steps.title: Play until done
steps.text: This block plays a sound and waits for it to finish before the next block runs. Use it to play sounds one after another.

steps.title: Try it yourself!
steps.text: I've added a “when this sprite clicked” block to your code area. Drag “play sound until done” under it, and add a second one under that with a different sound. Then click your sprite.

waitFor.label: Drag the “play sound until done” block under the hat block

tours.title: Change how it sounds
tours.description: Make a sound higher, lower, louder or quieter.

steps.title: Change the pitch
steps.text: This block makes sounds higher or lower, like a chipmunk or a giant. A positive number makes them higher.

steps.title: Try it yourself!
steps.text: I've added a “when this sprite clicked” block and a “start sound” block to your code area. Drag “change pitch effect by 10” in between them, then click your sprite.

waitFor.label: Drag the “change pitch effect” block above the “start sound” block

steps.title: Volume
steps.text: This block makes sounds louder or quieter. 100 is the loudest.
